{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically below true outcomes, showing a consistent under-forecast bias that persists throughout the 30-day horizon",
    "The forecast gap is largest at early forecast horizons and narrows as we look further into the future, indicating initial lag that gradually converges",
    "When current sentiment is positive (>=0.33), model forecasts are too low relative to true outcomes, suggesting sentiment momentum is under-appreciated",
    "When current sentiment is negative or zero, model forecasts overshoot slightly, showing mean-reversion bias when market sentiment is weak",
    "Forecasts exhibit less volatility than true outcomes, particularly in the first 10-15 day horizon where true prices show more price movement",
    "Model appears to under-capture price reversal points, especially when prices have been trending consistently in one direction"
] }
